test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 21 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following prestigious Indian cinema awards was conferred upon Mohanlal in September 2025 in recognition of his iconic contribution?

options.text: National Film Award for Best Actor, 2025

solution:
The correct answer is __**Dadasaheb Phalke Award, 2023**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In **September 2025**, the Government of India conferred the **Dadasaheb Phalke Award for the year 2023** upon the veteran actor **Mohanlal** for his iconic and lifetime contribution to **Indian Cinema**.
 
• Known affectionately as "The Complete Actor," **Mohanlal Viswanathan** has a prolific career spanning over **45 years**, during which he has acted in more than **360 films**, predominantly in the **Malayalam film industry**.
 
• The announcement was made by the **Union Ministry of Information and Broadcasting**, recognizing his versatility and impact on the cinematic landscape across multiple languages including **Tamil, Telugu, Hindi, and Kannada**.
 
• The **Dadasaheb Phalke Award** is the highest honor in Indian cinema, awarded during the **National Film Awards** ceremony by the **President of India**.
